[TODO:it] Travel only a single hour before arriving

the_road.title: [TODO:it] Stay Here With the Donkey
the_road.text:
[TODO:it] You come near the mountain.
What do you tell the servants?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you'
[TODO:it] 'Come with us up the mountain to watch'
[TODO:it] 'Take the donkey home; we are not coming back'

mountain_in_sight.title: [TODO:it] The Wood and the Fire
mountain_in_sight.text:
[TODO:it] You prepare to climb the mountain.
Who carries what?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Place the wood for the burnt offering on Isaac's shoulders; carry the fire and the knife yourself
[TODO:it] Carry the wood yourself while Isaac carries nothing
[TODO:it] Leave the wood behind at the foot of the mountain

leave_servants.title: [TODO:it] Father
leave_servants.text:
[TODO:it] As you walk together, Isaac speaks up.
What does he say?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Father â the fire and wood are here, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?'
[TODO:it] 'Father â let us go back home right now'
[TODO:it] Isaac says nothing the whole way up

isaacs_question.title: [TODO:it] God Will Provide
isaacs_question.text:
[TODO:it] You answer Isaac.
What do you say?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son'
[TODO:it] 'You are the lamb, Isaac'
[TODO:it] 'There is no lamb â we go home now'

summit.text:
[TODO:it] You reach the place God has told you about.
What do you build there?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Build an altar, arrange the wood on it, bind Isaac and lay him on the altar, on top of the wood
[TODO:it] Build a shrine to another god instead
[TODO:it] Refuse to build anything and turn back

the_binding.text:
[TODO:it] Isaac is bound on the altar.
What do you do next?

choices.text: [TODO:it] Reach out your hand and take the knife to slay your son
[TODO:it] Set the knife aside and refuse
[TODO:it] Loose Isaac and flee down the mountain

the_knife.text:

What does he say?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Abraham! Abraham! Do not lay a hand on the boy. Do not do anything to him'
[TODO:it] 'Strike the boy quickly â do not delay'
[TODO:it] The angel says nothing at all

the_stay.title: [TODO:it] Now I Know
the_stay.text:
[TODO:it] The angel explains why you were stopped.
What does he say?

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from Me your son, your only son'
[TODO:it] 'You have failed the test; go home in shame'
[TODO:it] 'Isaac must still die; try again tomorrow'

the_ram.text:

choices.text: [TODO:it] A ram caught by its horns in a thicket â you take it and offer it as a burnt offering in place of your son
[TODO:it] A dove flying above the altar
[TODO:it] Nothing at all â the altar remains empty

the_name.title: [TODO:it] The Lord Will Provide
the_name.text:

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'The Lord Will Provide' (Yahweh Yireh)
[TODO:it] 'The Place of Grief'
[TODO:it] 'The Mountain of Fire'

the_blessing.text:

choices.text: [TODO:it] 'I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore; through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed'
[TODO:it] 'Your descendants will be few and forgotten'
[TODO:it] 'You will lose all you have as punishment'
